items.title: Sid Davilla Interview, 1969-04-17
items.q: So when the opportunity presented itself, he did some off nights for us here. And then when it was time to change the band, we put George to work.

ctx.x: So, where did you, how was it that you had heard George play? Where did you heard him play before getting in here?

Records, first I heard him records. And then the Patek Lounge, which is on the other end of the block, they would bring in bands occasionally. They'd have a house band, and on the off night they would bring in a different band, another band. I guess the first time I heard George Lewis play in person was at the Patek Lounge. And I was impressed. What would be a clarinet player myself of some sort? I was impressed by his style and by his ideas and his technique. George got over the clarinet and put it on good. He…
Can you remember how long the engagements were?
